thread.document:
Dear students,

If you submitted HW0, you should now be in the class. 

If you did not submit HW0, you should now be dropped from the class.



If the above didn't happen for you properly, please feel tree to either respond in this thread (where everyone else can see --- so you probably don't want to do that) or make a private post here in Ed. You should not send an email to us about this. 

Hopefully, this being settled will reduce everyone's stress and you can focus on learning the material.
